# PlanckUi

> PlanckUi (https://plank-ui.design) is a free widget platform: 290+ copy-paste widgets for any website — testimonials, review walls, forms, social feeds, docks, counters and more. No signup, no watermark, no usage limits. Free forever, $0.

PlanckUi widgets are self-contained HTML+CSS snippets rendered in an isolated shadow DOM. Users customize them in a live editor ("Paint") and copy a single snippet that works on any website builder (WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, Shopify, Ghost, plain HTML). A native macOS dock app is also available.

## Key pages

- [Widget catalog](https://plank-ui.design/gallery): all 290+ widgets, searchable, grouped by 18 categories
- [Testimonial widgets](https://plank-ui.design/gallery?category=proof): walls of love, carousels, marquees, rating badges
- [Form widgets](https://plank-ui.design/gallery?category=collect): testimonial collection, contact forms, surveys, polls
- [MacBook Resources](https://plank-ui.design/macbook-resources): native macOS glass dock bars and desktop widgets (Swift + Übersicht)
- [PlanckUi vs Elfsight](https://plank-ui.design/vs/elfsight): free vs $15–40/month comparison

## Pricing

Everything on PlanckUi is free ($0). There is no paid tier, no watermark, and no account requirement for using widgets. An optional free account exists only for collecting live testimonial data.

## Facts

- 290+ widgets across testimonials, forms, social, commerce, media, developer tools
- Widgets render in shadow DOM: isolated styles, no layout shift, a few KB each
- Works on every website builder that accepts HTML embeds
- Owned and operated independently; launched 2026
